data.one_liner: Check and censor strings against profanity and obscene words with a built-in English list.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple Dart class to detect profanity, retrieve profane words, and censor strings. Includes a default English word list from LDNOOBW and supports custom words, additions, and exclusions.
use_when: You need to check user input for profanity in chat or comments.
You want to automatically censor bad words in strings with customizable lists.
avoid_when: You need advanced natural language processing beyond simple dictionary lookup.
strengths: Includes a default English profanity word list out of the box.
Supports custom lists, additions, and exclusions.
Case-agnostic censorship and exact substring matching.
weaknesses: Relies on a static word list which may miss creative spellings or context-dependent slurs.
